Findings: Portable view of the chest on 5/16/2021 at 1733 demonstrates interval
development of large right pleural fluid collection, with possible
underlying air space process such as atelectasis. There is also
persistent retrocardiac opacity and probable small left pleural
effusion. A tube in the subxiphoid region appears somewhat more
kinked compared to the prior study. Other tubes and lines appear
unchanged.
Followup on 21-05-16 at 2030 demonstrates marked interval decrease
in right pleural fluid collection. Retrocardiac opacity persists.
Interstitial prominence consistent with edema also persists. Since
the prior study, the tube previously located in tex subxiphoid
region appears to have either been removed and replaced or
repositioned. It now appears that there are two mediastinal
drains. There is also a new right subclavian line which extends to
the proximal right atrium, with no definite evidence of
pneumothorax. Other tubes and lines are unchanged.
Follow-up on 5/16/2021 at 0442 demonstrates interval increase in
confluence of retrocardiac opacity. Interstitial edema and
probable small bilateral pleural effusions persist. Multiple tubes
and lines are unchanged.

action.
